headline: AEGEAN: Turnover of €1.496 billion and net profit of €100.6 million in the nine-month period
summary: Aegean's nine-month turnover reached €1.496 billion and net profit €100.6 million. Aviation fuel costs rose to €408.1 million from €270 million a year earlier, before hedging effects.
why: Aegean Airlines is a Greek carrier based in Athens and a major airline in the Greek and Eastern Mediterranean markets. Fuel is one of its largest operating costs, so jet fuel prices strongly affect its margins.
